A '''targeting beacon''' was a device that allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to bomb a location regardless of the weather conditions. In [[3640 BBY]] during the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] of [[Kalandis Seven]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] gave a satchel of targeting beacons to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]], which she planted on the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]] to enable [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fighters to bomb it.

==Behind the scenes==
Targeting beacons first appeared in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'' which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] and released on [[October 23]], [[2012]].
